NewsArticle.Title: Maintenance
NewsArticle.Content: 01.05 11:59 p.m. - 01.06 03:00 a.m. Dark Ages, NexusTK, and their web sites will be unavailable during hardware maintenance. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, [test your connection.](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm)
